description: Wichita, Kansas -- Kansans for Life announced today that the pro-life organization is endorsing Kris Kobach for Kansas Attorney General. “With abortion extremists attacking pro-life laws in Kansas, the race for attorney general has never been more important,” KFL PAC Director Kristina Smith said.

title: Kris Kobach Endorsed by Kansans for Life in AG Race | Kris Kobach for Attorney General
